title: Built-in Diagnostic Suite Execution
description: When the diagnostics API receives a recognized built-in test type (e.g., 'speedtest', 'canvas', 'pcap'), it MUST execute the corresponding predefined diagnostic suite.

title: Custom Probe Execution via ID Match
description: When the requested test type is NOT a built-in test, but matches an ID in PROBES_DB, it MUST execute the target override or configured target using the custom probe's specified protocol type (http, api, dns, tcp).

title: Fail-Closed for Unknown and Unconfigured Test Types
description: When the requested test type is NOT a built-in test AND does NOT match any ID in PROBES_DB, the diagnostic run MUST fall back to the default 7-Layer OSI & SaaS Suite.

title: Overall Status Degradation
description: If any individual diagnostic probe step fails (passed=False), the final payload status MUST be 'FAIL' and the log output MUST record 'State: RED (FAIL)'.

title: DNS Custom Probe Resolution
description: When a custom probe with probe_type 'dns' is specified, it MUST execute DNS resolution verification for the target host.

title: TCP Custom Probe Execution and Port Parsing
description: When a custom probe with probe_type 'tcp' is specified, it MUST parse port configuration and execute TCP socket connection verification.

title: Fallback Probe Protocol Handling
description: When a custom probe with unrecognized probe_type is specified, it MUST fall back to default HTTP or TCP probe execution.

title: Live Diagnostics Custom Probe Propagation
description: The Live Diagnostics action center MUST dynamically load and display user-created Custom Probes from PROBES_DB in the test selection dropdown.

title: EasyBuilder HTTP 422 Alert Handling
description: The EasyBuilder save probe logic MUST catch non-OK REST responses (e.g., 422) and visually alert the user instead of failing silently.

title: Chromebook Lock Button State Binding
description: The dedicated Chromebook fleet view MUST dynamically evaluate settings_locked for each device and render the correct Unlock/Lock toggle state.

title: Chromebook Dynamic Identity Binding
description: The Chromebook fleet view MUST display true hostname and mac_address variables rather than hardcoded string placeholders.
